text.name: Handover of Hong Kong
text.rules: Record "one country, two systems" for the rest of the game. SAE spends 3 points. If this card's event happens, remove it from the game afterwards.
text.history: Britain returned Hong Kong to China on 1 July 1997; under the 1990 Basic Law the territory was promised a high degree of autonomy for fifty years, to 2047.
